test_cases.revision_comment: The headline feels too aggressive. Tone it down and make it warmer for the Mother's Day audience.
The hero image feels too cold and wintery. We need warm spring tones. Replace with a lifestyle shot.
The up to 40 percent off line in the hero needs the starting at minimum, and confirm Lancome is cleared with Merch.
We should be targeting Gold tier members only for this campaign, not all loyalty members.
Legal flagged that the disclaimer text is not visible enough on the email banner. Need minimum font size compliance.
The Spanish translation for the Puerto Rico market sounds too formal. Make it more conversational.
